//: Network-integration manifest for teams-agent. Describes how this agent is wired into
//flows: the enterprise network flows. Aggregated by the deploy-agent-network workflow.
//exposeToM365: true: published to Microsoft Teams / M365. YARP wires an explicit /teams/teams-agent edge route (edge deny-by-default: only wired agent paths reach APIM) and the Teams publish job runs. Removing this flag or the manifest would 404 the bot at YARP.
//exposeFoundryApi: false: NOT reachable through the governed Foundry Responses API path.
//tokenLimits: Omitted: the Teams (activityProtocol) path is governed by the Bot Framework validate-jwt policy on the APIM Teams API, not by the Responses token-limit policy.
